public_interfaces.future_consumers: Events/evaluation may consume dated primitive receipts, due amounts, item remaining/paid/writeoff/lineage and aging from this engine, not use score/delta as independent outcome labels. Export must adapt this core result to its future strict authorized API schema; it is not an implemented endpoint.

fixture_schema.identity: Only invented-company, bank, invented-core-fixture; synthetic a*64 source hashes, never audited real data
fixture_schema.records: Mapping from the ten sealed financial-v3-input-v1 record kinds to lists; absent collections are empty, never evidence of zero. Records use the unchanged contract.input_schemas().
fixture_schema.context: Unchanged contract.validate_context shape: month first-of-month, matching month-end as_of, exclusive next UTC midnight, policy version, company and view.
fixture_schema.obligation_coverage_semantics: A source-backed certificate of exhaustive legal-face/origination and amendment history, settlement coverage, forward contractual schedule vintage and comparable economic perimeter. Not just an available feed or a current outstanding snapshot. operating_ap scope covers other_payable too.
fixture_schema.principal_semantics: Atomic funded legal principal tranches or a single bullet, never a second aggregate loan balance on top of installments. Independent current-month principal observation is required to reconcile a nonempty loan perimeter.
fixture_schema.cash_cutoffs: opening/instant at measured_at mean booked-before that exact timestamp under supplied terms; closing includes that microsecond, mapped to measured_at+1 microsecond. Unknown never inferred from midnight. All coverage is half-open.

numeric_examples.interpretation: Invented arithmetic demonstrations only. Every band is unvalidated_internal; not externally adjudicated healthy/weak labels.

limitations_and_parent_actions: Parent alone updates .devin/goal.md. Worker did not edit it or any preexisting code/artifact, UI/API, configuration or dependencies.
Generic core is implemented and synthetic checks pass; real audit still lacks complete cash, obligations, historical availability and untouched confirmation data. No real headline is claimed.

Independent economic level review, predictive events/models/evaluation and confirmatory acceptance remain undone or blocked. No outcome labels were created, no fitting and no reserve evaluation occurred.

Foreign cash stocks are reconstructed natively then converted with dated stock FX; transaction FX is separate. Mixed-currency liability totals explicitly abstain until a comparable liability conversion contract is supplied; native items remain visible.
Only explicit bank-linked allocations are accepted. Missing/assumed allocations block headline; no ambiguous oldest-due fallback. Writeoff is tracked, not legal extinguishment or payment recovery.

Schedule changes use documented amendments/replacement lineage. Conflicting changed terms under an old obligation ID are rejected, not silently selected as a new vintage. Account version changes similarly require an explicit new perimeter.

Only as_of and reconstructed_retrospective are implemented; as_of_simulation is rejected without a separate implemented availability contract. Single cash anchors may yield displayed provisional balances but never an eligible headline.

Money uses Decimal and decimal strings, with local precision 80 for derived means/FX division/square roots. Legal sums are not float-rounded; repeating derived divisions are finite-precision Decimal, not exact rational identities. Ratios/score points are finite binary64, with explicit reconciliation and display residuals.

Supplemental coverage/minor-unit/observation evidence must be verified by ingestion review. Source shape and cross-record consistency checks do not independently establish truth of a supplied certificate.

Core output is an internal versioned JSON-compatible result, not the future API Quantity schema. Export should preserve native unknowns, known subtotals, source/known-on metadata, view and internal band qualifiers; do not silently coerce derived-precision money to input money limits.
Parent should perform the separate code/economic review and wire future events/evaluate/export through these interfaces. No full project/UI build was needed or run.
